findings.comment: Cover sheet legal description references 'Volume 73, Page 75' but the recorded plat is Volume 73, Page 76. Application legal description field shows 'V.73, P.6' instead of 'V.73, P.76'. Both contain inaccurate recording page references that do not match the actual recorded plat.

Discrepancy between cover sheet legal description (Page 75) and recorded final plat (Page 76). Cover sheet references 'Volume 73, Page 75, Plat Records of Travis County' but the actual recording is 'Volume 73, Page 76' per county clerk filing information and plat document. This discrepancy has not been explained or reconciled.

Tax Parcel Number shown as '308163' in the application, which is only 6 digits. Required format is 10 digits (e.g., '0406100252' as shown on Travis County Tax Certificate account number). Application must provide complete TCAD parcel ID in 10-digit format.

Only a Travis County Tax Certificate is provided in supplementary documents. TCAD appraisal printout documentation required to verify complete parcel information and confirm land value is shown separately from full property appraised value is not included in the plan set.

Recorded 1975 historical plat does not include the modern required acknowledgment language per LDC § 25-4-83. Plat shows notarized owner acknowledgment from 1975 but lacks the current verbatim language regarding responsibility for construction compliance, potential plat vacation, and no guarantee of variances. Applicability of this requirement to historical plats recorded under prior regulations is unclear from provided guidance.
